## Relationship between Youtube videos and the ads shown with them

### This is about exploring possible relationships and links between Youtube videos and the kinds of ads that are shown with them. 

```{r, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 5}
library(tidyverse)

csv_file <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/e/2PACX-1vRzdBAOKYWtUuHo441RMNpshtVHFwUOVy8r3zSQAg93L085n27Xj4xo-XIFfA-m37KE2S7allMnnJPC/pub?gid=1350542291&single=true&output=csv"

logged_data <- read_csv(csv_file)

latest_data <- logged_data %>%
  rename(vid_type = 2,
         vid_min = 3,
         ad_type_same = 4,
         ad_sec = 5,
         ad_skippable = 6,
         ad_skip = 7,
         ad_rating = 8)

# Percentage of ads that were unskippable
ad_skippable_vector <- latest_data$ad_skippable
total_ads <- length(ad_skippable_vector)
num_unskippables <- sum(ad_skippable_vector == "No")
perc_unskip_ads <- num_unskippables/total_ads
cat(round(perc_unskip_ads * 100, 2), "% of ads were NOT skippable.\n")

# Mean of video lengths in minutes
vid_min_vector <- latest_data$vid_min
cat("Mean of the length of videos was", round(mean(vid_min_vector), 2), "minutes.\n")

# Total time spent watching ads in seconds
ad_sec_vector <- latest_data$ad_sec
cat("Total time spent watching ads was", sum(ad_sec_vector), "seconds.\n")

# Range of ad rating
ad_rating_vector <- latest_data$ad_rating
cat("Range of the ad ratings was between", 
    min(ad_rating_vector), "and", max(ad_rating_vector), "\n")

# bar 1
latest_data %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_bar(aes(x = ad_type_same),
           fill = "#C9A0DC") +
  labs(title = "Are the ads even relevent to the video?",
       subtitle = "Comparing the number of times a relevent ad is shown vs irrelevent ad",
       caption = "Source: my survey on Youtube ads",
       x = "Relevency",
       y = "Number of ads")

cat("This seems to suggest that the ads shown are usually not of relevance to the video itself but possibly due to other factors such as personal account info, search history, or other factors.\n\n")

#bar 2
latest_data %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_bar(aes(x = vid_type, fill = ad_skippable)) +
  labs(
    title = "Does video type affect ad skippability?",
    subtitle = "Comparing video categories and ad experience",
    caption = "Source: my survey on Youtube ads",
    x = "Video type",
    y = "Number of ads"
  )

cat("We may be able to see a clearer trend with a bigger observational log size.\n\n")

#bar 3
latest_data %>%
  ggplot() +
  geom_bar(aes(y = ad_skippable),
           fill = "#E0FAE4") +
  labs(
    title = "Ad Skippability",
    subtitle = "Number of skippable vs non-skippable ads",
    x = "Number of ads",
    y = "Skippability of ads shown",
    caption = "Source: my survey on Youtube ads"
  )

```
